notes: I changed the model to predict the mean of each region (≈11.8 inside |x|<3, ≈0.5 outside) instead of a deterministic pseudo-random hash. E18 proved the plateau is also run-to-run noisy (same x gave different values in E12 vs E18), so no deterministic function of x can match; predicting the region mean is the best a noisy box allows.
